label: Uriel

text.BHSA 1CH 6:23: אֶלְקָנָ֥ה בְנֹ֛ו וְאֶבְיָסָ֥ף בְּנֹ֖ו וְאַסִּ֥יר בְּנֹֽו׃
text.KJV 1CH 6:23: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,
text.BHSA 1CH 6:24: תַּ֤חַת בְּנֹו֙ אוּרִיאֵ֣ל בְּנֹ֔ו עֻזִּיָּ֥ה בְנֹ֖ו וְשָׁא֥וּל בְּנֹֽו׃
text.KJV 1CH 6:24: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
text.KJV 1CH 6:25: And the sons of Elkanah; Amasai, and Ahimoth.

A.name: Uriel
A.line: son of Tahath (1CH 6:24), chief of the sons of Kohath (1CH 15:5)

B.name: Uriel
B.line: Levite ancestor, son of Tahath and father of Uzziah, in Kohath's genealogy

why: The repeated בְּנוֹ (“his son”) identifies Uriel as Tahath’s son and Uzziah’s father, matching B’s genealogical description. A states the same relationships, so this passage cannot distinguish the records or confirm A’s additional identification with the chief in 1CH 15:5.
